scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let html = fs.readFileSync('index.html', 'utf8'); html = html.replace('__BACKEND_URL__', process.env.BACKEND_URL || '').replace('__VAPI_PUBLIC_KEY__', process.env.VAPI_PUBLIC_KEY || '').replace('__VAPI_ASSISTANT_ID__', process.env.VAPI_ASSISTANT_ID || ''); fs.writeFileSync('index.html', html);"
